scope.text: Manifest variants (2–16 looks, id pattern, plain-text titles, default) with sdk 5; resolveVariant falls back to the default for null or unknown ids; context.variant is reactive and typed from widget.json; ld-widget check validates and ld-widget shot captures every look.

WidgetAppearance.variant stored per instance; the API normalizes legacy appearance rows to variant null; the settings panel has a Look select and Reset to defaults clears style, shadow, look and options while API keys stay set.

reka-ui upgraded to 2.11.0; the settings panel (Package, Appearance, Widget, footer) and built-in editors use Ui* controls on reka-ui Switch, Slider, RadioGroup, NumberField, ColorField, Field and Primitive buttons, styled by the screen theme.

A color setting type (#rrggbb, sdk 5) drawn with UiColorField; UiColorField opens a reka-ui popover with ColorArea, hue ColorSlider and an optional opacity ColorSlider, with a checkerboard swatch; shadow opacity moved into the picker.
SDK docs and the create-widget AGENTS.md template teach settings storage, reset, secrets, color settings and looks; showcase-clock 1.1.0 demonstrates three looks and a time zone setting.

decisions.text: The settings panel follows the resolved screen theme, never the widget's own style; screen themes cannot be No frame, so no fallback is needed.
Looks are a first-class manifest field with context.variant stored in WidgetAppearance, not a convention on top of settings; an unknown stored id shows the default and is never rewritten.
Reset keeps secrets; the confirmation says so and points to Clear.
Colour for widget authors is a host-drawn color setting rather than a Vue component exported from the SDK, so reka-ui stays out of the sandbox (user decision during review).
Opacity is a separate number beside #rrggbb, not an 8-digit hex, so board data and the API contract did not change (user decision during review).

items.change: A field-bridge helper connects reka Switch, Slider, NumberField and ColorField to FieldRoot labels and descriptions.
items.reason: Its code comment says these reka controls do not yet participate in FieldRoot.
items.effect: Labels, descriptions and errors associate with these controls as with FieldControl.

items.reason: Review findings and the user's request for a reka-ui colour picker.

excludedScope.text: Out of scope per spec: enum labels, variant previews, variants for ClockAnalog1, reka-ui in the dev shell, clearing secrets on reset, alpha in color settings, an SDK-exported colour picker component.

followUps.text: The plan's throwaway secret-probe package and the browser check of number and secret fields were not observed in this session; those fields are covered by unit tests only.
No example declares a color setting, so its panel row was not seen in the browser.

risks.text: Reset to defaults on a frameless widget clears its No frame style, so it gets the board's framed theme; this predates the feature and the spec keeps it.
